# ROGResult { #dyf.ROGResult }

```python
ROGResult(ontology, layers, excluded_nodes, total_coverage, bridge_edges)
```

Result of Recursive Ontological Generation.

ROG applies density-adaptive thresholding recursively:
1. Build ontology at high threshold (dense regions)
2. Recurse into outliers with lower threshold
3. Repeat until coverage target or min threshold reached
4. Knit layers together with bridge edges

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name           | Type                                                         | Description                                         |
|----------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| ontology       | [DAGTaxonomy](`dyf.ontology.DAGTaxonomy`)                    | The unified DAGTaxonomy                             |
| layers         | [List](`typing.List`)\[[ROGLayer](`dyf.ontology.ROGLayer`)\] | List of ROGLayer describing each recursion level    |
| excluded_nodes | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`)                     | Indices that couldn't be connected at any threshold |
| total_coverage | [float](`float`)                                             | Fraction of input nodes in ontology                 |
| bridge_edges   | [int](`int`)                                                 | Edges connecting different layers                   |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [get_layer_for_node](#dyf.ROGResult.get_layer_for_node) | Return which layer a node belongs to, or None if excluded. |
